# Unicode CLDR collation data (CLDR 47, UCA 16.0.0)

Vendored for the UCA collation feature (`sxml_uca_collation_feature`,
`src/collation_uca.c`, `src/collation_tailoring.c`, packet 7.15b, D220)
under D13 and D208. The release is pinned in `third_party/cldr.version`
(tag `release-47` of https://github.com/unicode-org/cldr, commit
`adbaf76bf62572cbfe2044564c40ed44beb00f8a`). sxml does not compile these
files in: hosts serve them through their resource resolver as
`SXML_RESOURCE_KIND_COLLATION_DATA` under `urn:sxml:collation-data:` and
the path below `common/` (D184, D189, D220). The QT4 and XSLT test drivers
serve this copy (`../cldr/common/` from their catalogs), and so do the
unit tests.

The subset is the CLDR root collation and the collations of the languages
D208 names (en, de, fr, it, es, nl) with their regional files, unchanged:

Each file was downloaded from
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unicode-org/cldr/release-47/<path>`.
Other languages work the same way when a host serves their files from a
CLDR checkout; the files of a language's regions (`fr_CA.xml`) are looked
up before the language's (`fr.xml`).

`src/collation_tables.c` (the reorder groups) is generated by
`tools/generate-collation-tables.py` from `common/uca/FractionalUCA_SHORT.txt`
of the same release (SHA-256
`15bc6d75e55547bd17799e625fe835d3c3698572b32b4e12f7f00616607d35a9`), which
is not vendored: download it to regenerate.
